title: Your RC1 review, complete: ten batches, twenty-five rules, RC2 next
headline: The series is complete: pages 1 to 45 in ten batches, all in your words, all routed. RC1 is now locked, at your word, and every change goes into RC2. The one thing that would stop the team working tonight is its schedule: most members moved themselves to day hours before Q6 was amended, so they would not wake until 08:00.

T1, T5, T11: punchlines first, logistics last, every page asked what it is for

for_you.detail: Only a member may change its own task; with your word, the conductor sets them and fires each once, so they wake tonight and start RC2.
